facts.fact: Petra 头灯碎后在完全黑暗里手脚并用往回爬，分不清方向。
facts.anchor: I turn around, inching on my hands and knees back the way I had come.

facts.fact: 她后悔没按 Ms. Opal 教的办法在深洞里拉一根引导绳。
facts.anchor: I should’ve set up a line so I could find my way back. Ms. Opal instructed us to do that if we were ever in these deeper, complex cave systems so we wouldn’t get lost.

facts.fact: 她靠嗅觉导航，想往气味最不发霉的方向走，但到处一个味。
facts.anchor: I take another deep inhale, trying to move in the direction that smells least musty, but it’s all the same.

facts.fact: 摸到洞壁后她给自己定下三步目标：找到隧道、弄到灯、救回 Jade。
facts.anchor: I’m going to find the tunnel. I’m going to get a light. I’m going to save Jade.

facts.fact: 右侧远处出现一点红光，她以为是 Jade 或别的潜水员。
facts.anchor: To my right, a red light glows in the distance.

facts.fact: 光源其实是一只 tombstepper 中间那颗头上垂下来的发光球，像假头灯。
facts.anchor: A glowing bulb hangs off a long appendage on its center head, bobbing and turning like a human’s headlamp.

facts.fact: 她手上旧伤没包好、血味加自己喊话，把 tombstepper 引了过来。
facts.anchor: From when I cut my hand jumping into the cave angler’s pit and poorly bandaged it. That paired with the fact that I practically hailed the tombstepper over here by calling out to it? Yeah, my location is not top secret.

facts.fact: 她摸到一块小石头，朝 tombstepper 身后扔过去引开它的注意力。
facts.anchor: I throw the rock as far as I can behind the tombstepper, aiming for the wall so the rock bounces and clatters around.

facts.fact: 她钻进隧道后被咬住，tombstepper 带刺的外骨骼勾住了潜水服的裤腿。
facts.anchor: I keep crawling forward, but the tombstepper’s prickly exoskeleton has snagged on the pant legs of my dive suit.

facts.fact: 她靠双臂往前拖，小腿皮肉被撕开，一路惨叫。
facts.anchor: I use my arms to pull myself forward, screaming as the skin rips from my calves.

facts.fact: 在窄道里她想起孤儿院的男孩 Clay，他去年在第二层探洞。
facts.anchor: my mind wanders to Clay, a boy from the orphanage who was exploring in the Second Layer last year

facts.fact: 救援者把 Clay 的髋关节弄脱臼想把他拉出来，Petra 和 Jade 捂住耳朵，那一招没有用。
facts.anchor: When rescuers dislocated Clay’s hips to make him more flexible to pull out, Jade and I huddled together, covering our ears. The screams were unbearable. And it didn’t even work.

facts.fact: Clay 在洞里卡了十二个小时，最终因倒悬太久心脏停跳而死。
facts.anchor: For the next twelve hours, Clay was trapped, contorted in a hole with broken hips. His heart finally stopped from being upside down too long.

facts.fact: 当年 Jade 回答 Petra：不会让她钻进爬不出来的地方，所以不必开枪。
facts.anchor: “I wouldn’t have to, Pet,” Jade said. “I wouldn’t let you crawl into a spot you couldn’t get out of in the first place.”

facts.fact: 爬到某个位置后她整个人卡住了，前后都动不了。
facts.anchor: I’m stuck.

facts.fact: 卡住时她感觉背包被拽住，说明是背包被东西勾住，而不是通道太窄。
facts.anchor: that’s when I feel it⁠—my backpack tugging. Something’s snagged on it.

facts.fact: 她翻 Henry 的背包想找灯，里面只剩蛋白棒。
facts.anchor: Please, let there be a light. I rummage through. Nothing but protein bars.

facts.fact: 她摸到 Henry 的头灯，已经烧成一团变形、没法修的铁块。
facts.anchor: When I reach his headlamp, it’s a misshapen lump, melted and unsalvageable.

facts.fact: 她看见 bonedrinker 的发光肠子蠕动，把黏液里那具男尸的肋骨和脊椎像融化棉花糖一样吸进细口器。
facts.anchor: The luminescent intestines of the bonedrinker undulate as its straw-like face siphons down the man in goo, his ribs and spine passing through the creature’s narrow proboscis like melted marshmallow.

facts.fact: 她只剩一个选择：先回地表换装备，再下来找 Jade。
facts.anchor: I only have one choice left: I have to go back to the surface, get new gear, then return down here and find Jade.

facts.fact: 天花板 Serpentes fungi 的微光照出出口，她抓住岩棱爬出洞穴。
facts.anchor: The Serpentes fungi slithering around on the ceiling disappear as a wave of fog rolls over. I grab onto the rocky ledge and begin to climb out.

facts.fact: 上路后她靠父亲留下的罗盘认方向。
facts.anchor: I move cautiously, occasionally checking the compass that used to be my dad’s.

facts.fact: 父亲的死因：在窄缝里找 Obscuris relic 时塌落进 clawripper 巢，被拉上来时右腿已被吃掉，失血而死。
facts.anchor: His crew told my mom that he was exploring a tight crevice, trying to find an Obscuris relic, but the ground was unstable, and he fell into a clawripper den. They tried to save him, but his right leg was eaten off as they pulled him up, and he bled out.

facts.fact: Petra 曾想把罗盘卖掉，理由是她怕这份纪念价值让自己变软弱。
facts.anchor: I told her it’s because I worried the sentimental value attached to it made me weak.

facts.fact: 她靠罗盘和一点蘑菇微光独自摸回 Asshole 洞口。
facts.anchor: I found it⁠—the Asshole. And I did it all on my own with my compass and a little bit of mushroom light.

facts.fact: 第二层的向导拒绝借灯，游客本来想答应。
facts.anchor: One tourist looks like she’s about to say yes, but the diver interrupts. “No, we can’t spare anything, sorry.”

facts.fact: 回第一层路上，她在 Obscuris Theater 遗址遇到的另一组潜水员和游客也不肯帮忙。
facts.anchor: On my walk back toward the First Layer, I pass another diver and tourist at the remains of the Obscuris Theater, but they’re not willing to help either.

facts.fact: 由此她说出：只有潜水搭档是靠得住的人。
facts.anchor: The only people that have your back are your dive partners.

facts.fact: 初遇时 Jade 从口袋里掏出半块燕麦棒扔给她。
facts.anchor: She fished out half an oat bar from her pocket and tossed it to me.

facts.fact: Jade 说完孤儿院在半英里外、只等了three秒就走。
facts.anchor: She waited all of three seconds, then started walking away.

facts.fact: 她在 Spine Woods 回忆被打断，回头看见一只巨型星鼻鼬蹲伏蓄势。
facts.anchor: I look over my shoulder to see the twitching, excited, crouched body of a giant star-nosed weasel.

facts.fact: 爬到约一百英尺高时她单手抓岩壁，另一手把 climbing cams 塞进裂缝做锚点。
facts.anchor: I hold on to the cliffside with one hand, using the other to grab my climbing cams and wedge them into the cracks in the wall.

facts.fact: 一只十五英尺翅展的巨型蛾用小腿钩住她背包，把她从崖壁上往外拖。
facts.anchor: The moth’s little grabby legs hook into my backpack, and it starts pulling me off the wall.

facts.fact: 连在安全带与 cam 上的绳索被拉紧，蛾才松手，她被甩回撞在岩壁上。
facts.anchor: The rope attached to my harness and cam pulls taut; the moth lets go.

facts.fact: 该对着几英尺外的目标喷 Beast-Away，但蛾又扑上来，她只能闭眼乱喷。
facts.anchor: I’m supposed to aim at something several feet away, but with the moth grabbing my backpack again, I have no choice. I squeeze my eyes shut, then spray and pray.

facts.fact: 辣椒雾灼伤眼和后，她在窄棱上坐下，抓水壶想冲脸。
facts.anchor: I perch on a narrow ledge and grab my canteen to dump it over my face.

facts.fact: 水壶空了，因为此前倒水冲洗橙色 glow gem 上的 bonedrinker 黏液。
facts.anchor: From when I poured the water to clean the bonedrinker slime off that orange glow gem.

facts.fact: 到第一层底部后她找到一株 Void aloe，掰下叶子把汁液涂在灼伤处。
facts.anchor: There, a few yards away in a dry patch of dirt, is a beautiful, spiny, bright-green succulent. Void aloe. I crawl for it, breaking off one of the leaves and spreading its soothing juice on my burns.

facts.fact: 本章结尾她一瘸一拐狂奔，直到抵达吊笼处，没有见到任何人。
facts.anchor: I burst into a limping run back toward the surface, and I don’t stop until I reach the lifts.
